notes.title: LINE OF SIGHT - REDUX
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25944055/eda6988f36375230a387f78895ed907ae4f8d2a9.jpg[/img]

We worked on the [b]overall feel and look of Line of Sight[/b]
Huge[b] changes to the economy[/b] which results in less grinding and more fighting!
Additional equipment balance with direct impact on weapon balance, system adjustments, and general balance.

The general grind in Line of Sight was quite extensive, not only because of general weapon pricing, part of it was the huge weapon customization system with countless parts of tuning for your lovely gun that all resulted in a high amount of GP needed for a fully new bought and kitted gun.

With the new adjusted prices and the Daily/Weekly/Monthly-Mission rewards additional to the general match-rewards available, the grind now will be much lower. 
More info about that and an additional renting system which was asked for down below.

[h1] GENERAL  [/h1]
[list]
[*] Added a new menu-background

[*] Added a new loading screen

[*] Added a new splash screen

[*] Noche disabled

[*] Banished disabled
[/list]

[h1]NEW CONTENT[/h1]
[list]
[*]New TDM Map : EXTENDED

[*]Camos for special Events and occasions. ([b]only obtainable via Cups/Events[/b])

[b]Based on the most played TDM[/b] map of Line of Sight, 
[b]EXTENDED is V2[/b] with a focus on balance and gunplay.

[b]Layout[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25944055/710ba55791d1357f4d8b3f48a8ff4050653321f2.png[/img]
[b]Overview[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25944055/f2cd8353bab394e80f96d0acd89388a269041e64.png[/img]
[/list]

[h1]BALANCING ADJUSTMENTS [/h1]
[list]
[*] Body Armor 
BPU nerfed (All BPU Vest)

Armor point 100 → 85

Removed stun resist (30% → 0)

Adjust Penetration resist 25 → 22
[/list]

[h1]BUGFIXES [/h1]
[list]
[*]Gray Gate
Fixed an issue, which made it possible to clip into a wall.

Fixed an issue, which made it possible to clip into a tree.

Fixed an issue, which made it possible to get out of the map

Fixed an issue, which was created by an asset.

[*]Desert Fire
Fixed an issue, which made it possible to get out of the map

[*]Showdown
Fixed an issue, which made it possible to get on specific roofs.

[*]Lucerne
Fixed an issue, which made it possible to get onto a spot in the spawn area.

[*]Savanna Flu
Fixed an issue, which made it possible to get onto the roof.

[*] Several smaller bugs fixed
[/list]

[h1]Changes in weapon economy[/h1]

[b]Weapons and equipment are being unlocked at a certain level.
It was focused to not lock away powerful weapons behind high levels only[/b]

[code][b][i]Added by demand a "1 Day Rental Option" for primary-weapons[/i][/b][/code]

That being said, the following [b][i]weapons got a  price overhaul.[/i][/b]
They are now obtainable without the previous heavy grind, [b]buy them - keep them - tune them![/b]

[h1]GIVEAWAY [/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25944055/bd84b0aca27fcd1ab41602378b93a8cef6ac66da.jpg[/img]

notes.title: [Announcement] Server Maintenance 08.03.2018, UTC 09:00, PDT 01:00 ( Expected Duration: ~30 minutes)
notes.notes:
Hi, Guys, We hope you guys enjoy playing Free-Weapon-For-All mode.
As we mentioned, it's an experimental mode and we are still getting user feedback how we should improve upon. 
So far, the feedback is both good and bad. We understand that your expectation was much greater than we expected. Having both TPS and FPS in a single mode have quite a bit of issues we need to solve. On top of that the loadout system completely changed under the hood to make it dynamic from static. We think it's little too early to call it a quit and we decide to give more life and see where it can lead us. There are still many bugs and we would like to fix bugs before adding more features and we hope that you have some more patience until it becomes more solid.  
Thank you very much for your support.

Here is the list of changes/bugs fixes for this week's patch.

* Fixed Airdrop destruction particle effect artifacts.
* 3P aiming made more accurate. It was difficult to accurately shoot the target.
* Shooting from behind from a corner in 3P made to land on the target closer to 1P shooting. You cannot hide in the corner and shoot anymore. 
* Quickthow bug. Sometimes the player still holds the Support weapon after a Quickthrow.
* Picking up a weapon when in barehand will still remain in barehand instead of switching the picked up weapon.
* Allows more Airdrop.
* Increased the chance of getting the primary weapons in the Airdrop
* Lifespan of initially dropped weapon will remain permanent. No auto disappear.
* Lifespan of dropped weapon is 120 seconds.
* Lifespan of Airdrop is 240 seconds.
* 3P weapon will fires from the actual weapon muzzle. 
* 1P Melee will target the center. The target was little off center before.
* Ammo count was showing wrong info when initially spawned.

* Facebook login fixed. 
* Default SnD round is now 7 instead of 12.

notes.title: [Completed] Server Maintenance 23.10.2017, UTC 04:00, PDT 00:00 ( Expected Duration: ~30 minutes)
notes.notes:
Hi, Guys, I hope you guys had good weekends.

As usual, we were busy listening to users and making updates to improve the game. As long as you support us, we will keep continuing working on it. ^^

Here are some improvements we made for this week.

1. Added "Forfeits" to Statistics. Some users were abusing "Early Quit" to keep the Win stats. With this update, it will no longer be possible. notes.title: [Completed] Server Maintenance 26.09.2017, UTC 04:00, 25.09.2017 PDT 21:00 ( Expected Duration: ~30 minutes)
notes.notes:
Hi, Guys, 
We are going to have a server maintenance for this week. 

We introduced the new modeless Matchmaking last patch but it was rather difficult to get it properly tested. The reason is partly that we have fewer players to participate and its modeless(non-intrusive) workflow was not very encouraging for users to participate. To increase the chance of MM, we propose the following changes. 

When you accept MM invitation, you will go to MM "Wait Others to Join" menu. 
When there aren't enough players to join, it will send additional invitations up to three times to users in the  Wait Queue, assuming there are users in the Wait Queue. And each time when it sends the invitations, we increase JoinBonus so that users will remain in the Join Menu.

That's it for now! We really hope it works better this time. Once it's proven that it works well, we will include more mode and parties. So please have little patience.  

Other changes: "Quick Match" and "Server Browser" buttons will be disabled while loading data. (Some thought that unresponsiveness to the button click was a bug and to make it clear, the buttons disabled while it's loading data) 

GG

Cheers!

Hi, Guys, 

Yesterday, we launched the new MM (Matchmaking) but due to a small number of players, it was rather impossible to test MM. We will temporarily change the MM the following ways so that we can at least test them until there are enough people start playing.

* Only Classic SND will be available to choose from. It is to keep everyone in one place. We will gradually open up more modes.

We hope you guys find the changes above is necessary for the test.

And we would like to remind you that MM can provide you more balanced game matches for both new and experience players (given there are enough pool) and it also gives you more game points plus some JoinBonusGP. So please use it more often if you can. 

Thank you very much for your support.

Cheers!

notes.title: [Completed] Server Maintenance 12.09.2017, UTC 12:00, PDT 05:00 ( Expected Duration: ~30 minutes)
notes.notes:
Hi, Guys, I have an exciting news to share. 
We are bringing a new Matchmaking system. The new system is quite flexible and I hope you guys will like it. Please let me describe how it works.

Old System: You have to click on "Start Matchmaking" and wait until a match is found. While waiting, you cannot do anything other than just waiting.

New System: You can click on "Start Matchmaking" and it will try to find a match for you in the background. You may do other things, including playing custom games. When it finds a match, it will notify you. You can accept the invitation and can start the match when enough people accept the match.
If not enough people accept the match, you will put back into the queue trying to search the next match. 

Other notes: 
* Matchmaking is trying to find the best balance. So if you are new players, matchmaking will more likely find a balanced match. So try to take an advantage of it.

* You will earn more GPs playing a game through Matchmaking.

* Matchmaking is level-locked at Level 1. We are trying to open it so that more players can participate but it can change depends on the user feedback. 

* There is JoinBonus. If you accept faster than others, you will slightly more bonus. So try to accept fast when you see the invitation notification.


Future plans: We are making "Individual Ladder" Matchmaking first. After stabilization, we will make "Party Invitation" and "Clan Ladders" in the near future. So please stay tuned.


Thank you very much and we really appreciate your support.

Cheers!

We will be also adding [b]2 new USA Variants[/b] of the rare weapons: M4A1 Raptor and L115A3 Precision, and a new Summer Character Variant! They will be only available for a limited time!

You can report bugs and other problems there!

[list]

[*] Added Bikini Version of Samantha Skin

[olist]

[*] Added "Firing Range" Button, that directly links players to the Firing Range
[*] The Tuning Button now directs players to the Weapon Inventory
[*] The Inventory Button now directs players to the Item Inventory
[*] The Equipment Button now directs players to the Character Choice/Customization Screen
[*] Added "Mini-Buttons", that link to the equipment/tuning screen of the loadout selected
[/olist]
[*] The Inbox will now be automatically opened after logging in the first time into the game
[*] Added system message informing players about the automatic host change
[*] The Area Icon in Domination will now be transparent 
[/list]

[h1]Balancing Adjustments [/h1]
[list]
[*] Lowered AR spread by ~50%
[*] Lowered SMG spread by ~50%
[*] Lowered MG spread by 20%
[*] Increased AR Recoil by ~10%
[*] Reduced movement inaccuracy for PSL, M14 and Dragunov
[/list]

[h1]Bugfixes [/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue, that caused the Edit Room Wheel to not disappear, when a user lost room master because of timeout
[*] Fixed UI Main Guide Button being broken for the main menu screen

[/list]

[b]There is something coming - and we want you to be a part of it![/b]

[b]- You are a content-creator? - Take part in our CERA-Task! - [/b]
(Content-Creator Early Review Access)

[b]- What is the "CERA-Task you may ask.[/b]
Its easy, "CERA" stands for "Content-Creator Early Review Access"
We grant you early access to the teased weapons/items for free and all you have to do is to create a video about it. Create a review, a montage or what ever you like - in the end it only should be helpfull or fun to watch.
Keep in mind that you are going to use non public released items/weapons,
Your opinion about it not only matters for us also for the user who watches the video.

We love our community and we love the content they create.
So we thought why not offer them a special deal!
We will feature your video on our social media pages because reviews are helpfull and videos in general are fun for everyone!

[b]- How to be a part of the "CERA-Task"?[/b]
Tell us who you are, why and how you want to be a part of our "CERA-Task".

Your first CERA-Task awaits, what are you waiting for?
Apply now!

Hello!

This time, we are having a patch with several gameplay changes, and some other stuff, that was heavily requested! We also lowered weapon prices by quite a bit.

We want to remind you, that we have a support system, which you can find here: https://support.los-game.com/ 
You can report bugs and other problems there!


[h1]Shop Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Lowered temp and permanent Weapon Prices by ~20%
[/list]

[h1]Changes [/h1]
[list]
[*] Changes "Match is over soon" Message to be triggered  at a later point in the game (~50% of match -> ~60% of match)
[*] The Back Button in a match found through Fast Start now redirects you to the Server Browser instead back to the Main Menue
[*] GP earned through Achievements and Missions are now displayed in the After Match Report. (Mission Rewards still need to be claimed in the mission overview)
[/list]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25944055/c056713c8d3462a1f882a4b2628cc23dd9899dbb.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Slightly adjusted weapon recoil of all weapons to compensate the changes made to other systems (Should be now between ~5% higher for all weapons
[/list]

[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue, that caused weapon recoil to behave unpredictably while moving.
[*] Fixed an Exploit, that made it possible to fire the M870 in extremely rapid fire
[*] Possibly fixed the Cheytac Achievement not counting properly
[/list]

[h1]Map Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Sentry Patrol: Fixed a spot, on which it was possible to blink out of the map
[*] Savanna Flu: Fixed a spot, on which it was possible to blink out of the map
[*] ShowDown: Fixed a spot, through which it was possible to run out of map

[/list]

[b] Please report all map bugs you can find to us so that we can fix them as soon as possible! [/b]

notes.title: Dev Blog 4: Upcoming Matchmaking Changes
notes.notes:
Some time has passed since the last Dev Blog, and we feel, that its time to start doing them again ^^

This time, we want to talk about the Matchmaking System in general, and the upcoming changes for it.



[h1]Current Situation:[/h1]

We currently use a 'mixed' system to find matches for players. This is split up into:

(Unranked) General Matchmaking
(Unranked) Server Browser Matches
(Ranked) Individual/Clanwar Matchmaking

In General Matchmaking, players can search a match in their preferred mode & setting (Psyonic/ESP/Classic).
In Server Browser Matches, players can just create a lobby, and wait for players to join.
In Ranked Matchmaking, players are matched up with other players of similar rank (as much as possible).

Using this system, we are offering players a big choice over how they want to play the game. Want to play competively? Play Ranked! Want to find a match very quickly? Use the General Matchmaking! Do you want to play with your friends alone? Create a room in the Server Browser!


This system, although working in theory, has a big flaw: It needs a very high playercount to work reliably, otherwise players wont be able to find other players to play with,as it is essentially splitting the playerbase into 3 parts. (and these parts then are further splitted under the respective modes)
This has proven to be a problem especially in areas of the world, where the playercount is relatively low. Players in these areas often try to find a match in the general matchmaking, but are not able to, because not enough players are searching


That is, why we will be changing the system in the near future to provide you with an even better experience!


[h1]Upcoming Changes:[/h1]


To improve the situation, we will be merging the Server Browser and the General Matchmaking System.


[img]http://i.imgur.com/EzYHZc9.jpg[/img]
[i]Quick sketchup of the new main menu choice.[/i]


In the main menu, you will have 3 choices: "Quick Join", "Server Browser", and "Ranked Matchmaking"!

The Server Browser functionality won't be changed, it will just redirect you to the usual server list/lobby list.

The Ranked Matchmaking Button will direct you to the same Matchmaking System, that you are used to, but you will only have 2 modes to choose from: "Individual and Clanwar".


[img]http://i.imgur.com/P3Wc8el.jpg[/img]
[i]New Ranking Screen [/i]


The Quickjoin Button will open up the following window:

[img]http://i.imgur.com/uE3o20x.jpg[/img]
[i]The menu, that opens after pressing "Quick Join"[/i]


There you can choose the mode & map, that you want to play in. This system them will find you a room with these settings!

The big difference compared to the current Matchmaking System is, that the Quick Join Function will find you a match in the Server Browser! So instead of splitting up our community into 3 chunks(General MM, Server Browser, Ranked) , we will focus the playerbase into 2 groups: "Unranked", and "Ranked". We hope, that this change will help you find a match more quickly!



[h1]Future Plans[/h1]

We still have a lot of changes coming up in the future for these system, for example:

- Ranked Restriction: Players below a specific level won't be able to participate in Ranked Matches
- Ranked Rejoin: Players, that leave a Ranked Match will be able to rejoin it
- Penalties for leaving: Players, that leave a ranked match will receive a temporary matchmaking ban
- Parties in Quick Join: You will be able to invite your friends into a "Quick Match Lobby", and then together find a match





Please tell us what you think about these planned changes.

We also now have new way for you to get in touch with us! Just join our Skype Feedback Group by [url=https://join.skype.com/it8x0QWz7FZo] clicking on this link.[/url]

Thank you for reading this Dev Blog, and have a good day!

notes.title: Clarification on the last patch
notes.notes:
Hi guys, 

===================================================
Update:

We are currently actively fixing the throwing knife bug. The bug is a known  Unreal Engine bug that they never bother fixing it. 

If you are curious, you can read this thread.
https://forums.epicgames.com/udk/udk-development/udk-programming-and-unrealscript/287784-collisions-physic-asset-trace-and-multiplayer-game

However, we are trying to find a workaround to support it. We will be able to give you another update next week. 
===================================================

There were couple of changes that generated quite a bit of turmoils in the last patch.

1. Removing SnD, and TSV from General MM:
   General MM is has quite a few modes to select from and it takes long time to find matches. SnD and TSV by nature is competitive. Individual Ranking already support SnD, and TSV and we thought it will be better to redirect players to Individual Ladder who want to play SnD and TSV.

And of course, they are always available from Custom Matches. 

This is not the final decision and if there are reasonable requests, we can change it again. 

2. Disabling Throwing Knife. We changed internally how collisions are handled to optimize collisions. We found that there is bug related throwing knife and we temporarily disabled it until we find solutions. We will try to bring it back but for some reason, if we decide to keep this way, we will refund the money. Besides the bug, it creates some balancing issues and we are currently discussing at the same time.

Cheers!

notes.title: [Completed] Server Maintenance UTC 09:00, PDT 13:00, Expected Duration: 1 hour
notes.notes:
Hi, guys, 

It's about time for a patch.

The biggest news today is, we are introducing a new map called, Black Syndicate, a SnD map.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25944055/a85f9bdbf6e9496a4f169202ddeb58a89e9fe2b6.png[/img]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3CNS2AUnP34

And thanks for overwheming participating to ESL tournament.
As a response the overwhelming response, we decide to release the SnD map.
We will go though some testing and make it available for ESL.

And also we monitored some abusing behavior for leaving early (by force-quit) in the middle of the match to skip loosing points.
Force-quitters (closing window, process-kill) will be penalized 2 times more than just a game loss.
So, please think twice before you quit.

Here are other patch notes.

* New Black Syndicate map
* Make steam purchase messagebox cancel-able
* Give penalties (2 times more than a match loss) to user who leaves from ladder matches early or by force-quit 
** Added notice in Matchmaking warning "Force-quit (killing the client) in the middle of Ranking Matches will result in more penalties than the normal. So please do not quit in the middle."  
* Removed "game" from bad-word IGN filter
* Changed idle timeout to 120 seconds from 80 seconds
* Optimized all vehicles
** Fixed bullets going through some vehicles. Now collision will be handled correctly
* Fixed map glitches. SavannaFlu, Sentry Petrol
* Changed Desert Eagle Car14 weapon state display the same as normal DE
* Disable throwing knife (Downrange, Bulls-Eye) throwing ability 
* Lowered crouch eye position by 8 cm to reduce head-glitches
* Expanded Max Clan Members to 100 from 50
* Removed Team Survivor and SnD mode from General Match Making. (It will be playable from Ranking Match Making only)

Cheers!

notes.title: Known bugs in Matchmaking
notes.notes:
Hi, guys, we realize that many people likes to use Matchmaking more than we expected and we are going to put high priority fixing/improving Matchmaking. We just added auto-region selector and it seems to be working quite well, however there are some known bugs at this moment and let us tell you.


1. Matchmaking takes longer than the display. This is because, Matchmaking uses total number of users in all Matchmaking servers. When we first introduce Matchmaking, there was only on channel but now we have multiple channels. We will take the current channel you select into account when displaying estimated time. 

2. Matchmaking sometime give you unbalanced player like 8v6, 6v5, and etc. We are going to fix the bug and let you know once it's fixed. 

I'm sure there are more bug in Matchmaking but the above two are the most frustrating bugs. If you know know, please leave it in the comment and we will take a look.

Thank you very much.

Cheers!

notes.title: [Completed] Server Maintenance UTC 08:30, PDT 00:30, Expected Duration: 1hour
notes.notes:
Hi, Guys,

We had quite bit of unstable server yesterday and we really apologize for the inconveniences.

We promised to bring better Matchmaking experience by selecting the closest Server from your location and we are ready to deploy it.

It looks up your IP address location from a DB and this DB is not perfect all the time. Therefore you might get some random location and it will depends on who your ISP is.

But most of them should be just fine.   If you are curious if you are getting the right location, please go visit http://freegeoip.net and check if the location shows correctly. And please report to us. If there are many users who reports wrong location, we will probably have to find some other ways.

Anyway, this will make Matchmaking experience much better and we also optimized our network in this patch.


Thank you very much for your support and let us know your feedback to our forum. 

Cheers!


[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] The Matchmaking System will now automatically choose the server with the best Ping
[/list]
 
[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed several collision issues on Sentry Patrol
[*] The machines on the A Spot in Sentry Patrol now properly stop bullets
[*] Fixed an issue, that would make the L115 extremely accurate in specific situations
[*] Fixed the Deagle Car14 having different stats than the GP deagle
[/list]
We really hope to stabilize the server situation as soon as we can.

notes.title: Official Free-to-Play release on Steam
notes.notes:
Hi, Guys,  It's live now!

Today is probably the biggest day for BlackSpot Entertainment.

We are officially releasing Line of Sight on Steam as F2P. Everyone waited so long and we been working hard for this day.

Regardless of the outcome, we are very proud that we pull it off against all odds we faced as small independent developer.

We would like to take this opportunity to thank many who helped us to get us this far.

We know Line of Sight wasn't perfect and we worked really hard to listen to the community to improve the game. Without our supporters help, it would've been very difficult, if not, impossible to release the game.

We are still far from perfect right now either, but if you take a look what we did in the past, you can probably believe that we will continue to improve the game with the same dedication. But to improve faster pace, we ask you to continue to support us. Your kind supports and encouragements mean a lot to us, more so than the profits.

Cheers!

https://youtu.be/twMH9Qn8qZA

notes.title: Line of Sight Basic Tips/Guides #1
notes.notes:
Hi, Guys, 

Here are some tips and guides for new users.

We get lots of common questions, for example, how to earn GPs, if Line of Sight is P2W, weapons are too hard to control and etc.

Here are some explanation on the common questions.
First of all, we have several ways to earn GPs. If you take an advantage of "Missions" rewards for example, you will never run short of GPs

Line of Sight is NOT PAY-TO-WIN and we will always stay this way.

Lastly, Line of Sight seems to have more weapon recoils than other similar games but actually, if you know how the pattern works, you can control the recoil and weapon control will be much easier and predictable than other games.

Please enjoy!

https://youtu.be/aOEypah7q_A

Cheers!

notes.title: Open Beta on Global Channeling
notes.notes:
Hi, Supporters!

Thank you very much for your support for the Free Weekend Event. 
We were successfully able to finish the event without much troubles and it helped to give us valuable feedback.

As we promised earlier that we will decide whether to go F2P during the Early Access after users feedback, we think it's clear that we should go F2P. 

But why the delay? At this stage, we would like to go F2P as soon as possible but please remember the reason why we needed the Early Access. The game is far from perfect and we need to make sure it is ready for the wider access.

There are few areas that we need to make improvements such as making the game more balance with different skill set, including fixing bugs and tuning.
We will do our best to make it reasonable.

Although we need little more time but we are going to make an option for user to play the game for free.

Please think of today's announcement is a step closer going to F2P on Steam. We have a partner who helped us a great deal to bring the service to Steam and we are going to make our game available from our partners channel.

You can sign up and download the game from our partner's site, www.gamengame.com  from Wednesday, December 7th 22:00 GMT+9 / 05:00 GMT-8 .

Whether you play through our partner's site or Steam, you are playing on the same servers. It's exactly the same game except that Steam user will get 500 Free Gems and all our steam users will get exclusive Early Access Emblems. (We will issue the emblem in the near future, before Steam goes to F2P at the latest)

Please remember we are still in Beta stage and having your feedback will help us great deal to improve our game.  

We really appreciate for your support, let's try to make the game a success.

Cheers!

notes.title: Starters Pack will no longer be free!
notes.notes:
Hi, Supporters!

Thanks guys for participating in Early Access. As a token of appreciation, we gave Starters Park for free, as a part of the base Early Access. 

We are removing Starters Pack from the base Early Access and we will make them as a DLC pack soon. The cost of Starters Pack will increase, more than the current base access fee.


You might want to ask, will the base Early Access be cheaper? The answer is, Yes. As the result of the separation, the base access will be cheaper. That's the main reason to make the base access easier.

But if you were to buy the base Early Access and the Starters Pack together later, costs will be much higher after the separation.

We will make the announcement about the exact price soon but we would recommend to act now rather than waiting after the separation.
The Starters Pack has value much more than what we are asking already. 

Thanks for your support!

Cheers!

Here is this week's patch note. 

It doesn't seem a lot but the automatic User Translation File Installation took little longer than expected. 
Instead of manually downloading and installing the translation files into the client, users can choose the language and it will automatically install them when they first start the client for the first time and the language can be changed in Options Menu later. 

We will see you with more updates next week! 
Please enjoy the rest of the week and don't forget the ESL Cup on Saturday.

Cheers!

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Removed stun effect for pistol and SMG
[*] Reduced weapon GP price by 30% (Permanent weapon system may require repairs in the future)
[*] Mission rewards reduced by 50%
[*] Added automatic installation of user translation files
[*] Increased attachment and armor price by 50%
[/list]
 
 
[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed several issues on Savanna Flu
[/list]

notes.title: [Completed!] Server Maintenance UTC 09:00, PDT 02:00, Expected Duration: 30 min.
notes.notes:
===========================
UPDATE: we found a side-effect with 300 FPS, until we find the problem, we will lock it at 150 FPS. Sorry about the unexpected changes.
===========================

How are you guys doing?

We just shared that Line of Sight is listed on ESL and we will have the first ESL Cup on Oct 22th 2016.
E-Sport is the core of our game and we will try to support as much as we can.
We were quite busy trying to come up with the best idea to support E-Sport this week.
In preparation for the upcoming ESL Cup, we added  the ESL Search & Destroy mode under Classic with the default ruleset.
We will continue to support E-Sport with special modes in the future and the mode configuration will change, if so desired.
Anyway, we hope as many users as possible to participate in the Cup and we will continue to have more Cups with awesome prizes down the road!
 
 
[h1]Balancing Adjustments[/h1]
[list]
[*] The Combat Mastery "Blood Sucker" has been nerfed (from 10/20/30 to 5/10/15)
[*] The Combat Mastery "Explosion Master" has been nerfed (from 10/20/30 to 5/10/15)
[*] The Combat Mastery "Sprinter" has been nerfed (from 15/30/45 to 10/20/30)
[*] The Combat Mastery "Conquer" has been nerfed (from 20/40/60 to 10/20/30)
[*] The Combat Mastery "Psyonic Master" has been nerfed (from 20/40/60 to 10/20/30)
[*] The Combat Mastery "Rear Attack" has been nerfed (from 30/60/100 to 10/20/30)
[*] The Combat Mastery "Explosion Damage Reducer" has been nerfed (from 13/26/40 to 10/20/30)
[*] The Combat Mastery "Psionic Damage Reducer" has been nerfed (from 13/26/40 to 10/20/30)
[*] The Combat Mastery "Blood Sucker" has been nerfed (from 30% to 10%)
[/list]
 
 
[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Standard characters will now come with an Merc Light BDU Vest
[*]Added an "ESL Search&Destroy Mode" with the current ESL Ruleset
[*]Increased maximum FPS to 300
[*]Sniper Rifles now need to be fully zoomed in to be accurate
[*]"Connection Time" Weekly Ranking Reward changed to "Gameplay Time"
[/list]
 
 
[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue with the crosshair while crouching
[*]Fixed an issue while spectating other players
[*]Fixed an issue while being shot with an Pistol/SMG
[*]Fixed several map exploits on Sentry Patrol
[*]Fixed an security related issue
[*]Server Connection Error for some routers.
[/list]

[*] The Combat Mastery "Fatal Headshot" has been nerved (from 25% to 15%)
[*] The Combat Mastery "Health Booster" has been nerved (from 10/20/30 to 5/10/15)
[*] The Combat Mastery "Health Recovery " has been nerved (from 3HP/s to 1HP/s)
[/list]
 
 
 
[h1]Changes[/h1]
 
[list]
[*]Adjusted outline visibility slightly on Non-Minimum settings
[*]Added an 12 rounds option to Search & Destroy
[*]Helmets will now be sold for Gems, as they do not give any advantages anymore
[/list]
 
 
[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]
 
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue with sounds not being played
[*]Fixed an client crash while changing graphic options
[*]Fixed several map exploits on Sentry Patrol
[*]Fixed location issues while planting the bomb
[*]Fixed several security related issues

notes.title: Please support us!
notes.notes:
Hi, Supporters and Friends.

I seems like most of you like our last update. If you have been following us, we are sure you will agree that we work with our community very closely and work very hard to bring the best possible user experiences.

Asking EA with some fee is very difficult to keep the user-base high because many of you have had bad experiences with EA games. We fully understand. And this is the reason why we are writing this message to clear some doubts.

Ok, we  hear some concerns for the hesitations to join us.

Many has asked when we are going F2P. Honestly, we don't know yet. If possible, we would like to keep stay as is to keep the healthy community. 
Having largest userbase is not our only goal. We would like to have healthy community first and grow even if it takes time. Luckily, we have very good community right now and we need to grow in size just little bit more. You can visit us our forum and FB fan page to see how our community is like. We are pretty certain that you will feel right at home.

Many also asked if they game will not go away soon. We understand that many similar FPS online game has gone because it doesn't cover their large operation cost. They are serviced by large companies, therefore, if it doesn't cover their operation costs, they will just have to stop. But we can tell you that we are small developer and publishing it ourselves. This means that there is no one to tell us to fold the game and as long as we are in business, we will continue to service the game. But we need your small help to fund the development to bring more contents faster.

We just hope that you will give us a chance by at least giving a try. If you think about it, we are not asking a lot but it is very important that we have larger userbase to make the game more fun. For example, we already have good Match Making system but we are waiting for the right moment to introduce. It requires slightly more users to function properly. 
If there is one thing we can promise, we will continue the development path the same as is right now and try to work with our community closely.

It seems like most of you likes our last patch. It goes to tell how much we are committed. And please compare this kind of commitment with other games and see how we are different. We hope this clears some doubts if you are still contemplating to join the community. If you like what we have done so far, please support us by joining the community, telling your friend to join, and writing Steam review. ^^

Thank you very much and please enjoy playing the game.
If you have any other doubts, please ask and visit our forum forum.los-game.com We have our dev-team and many users who are willing to help you.

Cheers! 

Chris Kim on behalf of Line of Sight dev-team.

notes.title: [One Time Event!] Free Gems ($5 Game Cash) + EXP & GP Boost until Sep. 25th!!
notes.notes:
Hello Steam Game Fans and Supporters!
It has been about a week since we launched [b]Line of Sight.[/b] To celebrate the successful launch and to thank our fans, and as well as to give great incentives to new users, we are going to throw an awesome event. If you are contemplating to join [b]Line of Sight[/b] community, this is perfect time to join. There are hundreds of users who are already satisfied and enjoy playing our game.

If you are already enjoy playing [b]Line of Sight[/b], please tell your friends about this wonderful opportunity to join the community until the time runs out.


To find out what everyone has to say, please read our Steam review and also visit our FB and LoS Forums for more information.
From long before the launch, we worked with our community very closely and you will easily find out how hard we work with the community and how we are different from other big companies. Community is at the core of the development and please join our wonderful community and we won't disappoint you!

https://www.los-game.com/
https://forum.los-game.com/

*[i]500 Free Gems will be given out after the event is over.[/i]

notes.notes:
=======================================
Update: Hi, Guys, we have to tell you a very bad news. We found a critical bug with Zombie Defense mode while testing at the final minute. There were some changes made to the map and we are afraid we will have to make a separate patch tomorrow. 
We are so sorry and we appreciate for your understanding. 
Thanks.
=======================================

[b]Hello supporters![/b]  Hope all of you guys had a good weekend. 

We are going to make a server patch today Sep 12th 2016 at 13:00 UTC (06:00 PDT) for about 1 hour.

[h1] [strike] New Zombie Defense Mode in the patch! ![/strike][/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25944055/2dd733635fd00aeb3cf6893736c019c3abc96cf1.jpg[/img]


We listened to your concerns and here are the changes we are making today!

[olist]

[*]	Adjustments in GP item prices. 

     [list]
[*] We adjusted rental prices significantly for weapons and few other items. We try to make balance between the right amount of effort to purchase items without making too easy or too hard. Analyzing the data, we agree that rental prices should be much cheaper even though we give many achievements and level up rewards. 

   [*]  	GP permanent weapon price adjustment: We are making adjustment to GP perm weapons but not as much as the rental adjustment. The reason is that our permanent weapon does not require repairs. We chose this way to make the players to benefit in the long term and earning a perm weapon should feel like a winning a prize. 
[/list]

[*]	Mission reward adjustments. 

      Because we adjusted item prices significantly, Mission reward will be reduced. Mission rewards should be optional and instead of mandatory task to earn enough GP to purchase items.


[*]	Servers Changes: There were many users who suffered from the high latencies and we are changing the location and adding a new server to lower the latencies. We will keep monitor the latency situation and make necessary adjustments to the servers constantly. 

[list]

     [*] 	Both NA 01 and NA 02 channels are used to be located at West US and we will migrate it to Central US to make users in NA to play the game with equal low latencies. 

      [*] A new Asia East server will be added to cater players from the Far East.

     [*] The existing Asia server will change its name to Asia SEA server.


[/list]

[*]	Level required to create a Clan will be reduce from 21 to 16. Many of you wanted to create the clan sooner, so we lowered it.   

[*]	New contents

     [list] 
	[*] Weapons: SCAR-H and MP5

      [*]	Zombie Defense Mode: Many of you guys asked us to open zombie mode sooner and we comply.
[/list]

Today’s patch is only the server side patch and we are trying to make another a client patch in next a couple of days fixing many bugs. We hope you guys stay with us while we make the changes and we will do our best to make you guys happy. 

==============================================
Update: We will include client patch with minor bug fixes. 
[list]
[*] Floating AI character in the air
[*] Disappearing clan mark when the description is changed.
[*] few minor string fixes
[/list]

[/olist]

Cheers!

notes.title: Thank you guys once again!!!
notes.notes:
Hi, Supporters!

We just turned "Mostly Positive"!!!

It took little of time but we knew after some adjustment period, users will appreciate our game eventually. We have many new systems, and many different game options compared to other similar games because we believe providing options are the better for the players. It could put you into unfamiliar territory but once you break the ice, you will appreciate what we are trying to do. Since we provide 3 different game modes, we have rooms to make the game experience satisfied from competitive players to casual players. For us, it’s like making three different games into one and it isn’t easy to make the experience unique enough and yet, balanced.

And please understand that the current versions is not the finished product and we are fixing bugs and tuning it constantly it to make it more perfect.  For instance, we hear that our GP weapon prices are too high. We heard your opinions and we will adjust it very soon. But there is one thing we would like to explain related to it. Our perm weapons appears to be expensive but our weapons does not require repairs. We could have made the perm weapon prices much cheaper like others but we chose it the other way to make the players life easier. Once you own it, you own it for good without paying repair cost thereafter. We wanted getting a perm weapon feels like you are winning a prize. If you prefer the other way around, please share you thought and we will listen. 
Besides, there are lots more contents and systems we haven't shown yet and we will bring them to you one-by-one in the near future.

Anyway, we are so excited now. We think "Mostly positive” marks the turning point and it tells us we weren’t wrong about our philosophy. We like to celebrate this moment and we want to run some promotional campaign that both existing users and new users can benefit. Please stay tuned for the upcoming announcement. 

Cheers!
[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25944055/34316d0dcec4a782a5911cb6dc75aa4f221bee85.png][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25944055/7f95439a8e61f64762bc227443244061280169ee.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Thank you for support to make the launch a success!
notes.notes:
Hi, Supporters!

My name is Chris Kim, CEO of BlackSpot Entertainment. 

Past a couple of days, we were really busy trying to release the game as we promised and we are really proud that we delivered it. However, we didn't even had a chance to thank you to everyone who helped us. It was quite a journey and we believe we had smooth start without major issues relatively. So we would like to take this opportunity to thank all our supporters and explain few things. 

If you read, "Why Early Access", you will probably understand what we are trying to do in EA. It is very difficult or impossible for us to self-publishing after Nexon dropped us. We really need your support to keep the project going. That's why we are charging small access fees. This fee will help us fund the project and shape the game to everyone's liking. Self-publishing had one advantage that other publisher owned games don't have though. We work with our community very closely all the time listening and applying the suggestion immediately, and we will always try to support you as much as possible. You can find out what we have been doing on our Facebook pages below to track it yourself. 

Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/LineOfSightGlobal/ 
Community Group: http://steamcommunity.com/groups/LineOfSightGlobal 

We know LoS is far from perfect and we are diligently working on it, but we really need your support to give us a chance. It breaks our heart when someone look at only the surface. We still have lots more contents to show in the near future. We deliberately didn't show everything so that we can focus on few things at a time. For example, we already have a very good Match Making system but it requires sufficient number of users to work properly. We are just waiting for the right moment to release it. We also have several more game modes. We didn't want users to be spread to many different modes initially either. We have many other stuff that we will deliver in timely manner. So please give us the chance to show them. 

Having said that, we will make quite bit of adjustments to your requests. The discussion has already begun, regarding weapon balance, weapon controls, character movements, making items more affordable, right level ups efforts, and etc. 

Also we listened for network delays. We will do the best we can to bring more server where it makes sense.  We are currently trying to figure out where to put more servers to reduce the delay. For NA servers,  we thinking about having servers in Central area so that everyone can enjoy lower delay, and we are also considering more Asia servers and of course, more EU servers as we grow larger. 

We think that the Early Access is the place for making such adjustments and not the place to present the final product. If you agree, you will see many updates from us in the near future and we hope we make the process together. 

Thank you very much for your support and we will stay in touch! 

Cheers!

notes.title: Hello from BlackSpot!
notes.notes:
Hi, Supporters!

We are working on a Release Candiate build right now. We will go though several interations for getting feedback and fixing bugs. If we don't see major issues, we will go live soon. Our target is still September, however we would like to make it early September rather than late September. We would like to ask for your support to make this possible by helping us to find critical bugs and giving us kind support for launch from visiting our FB sites below. 

https://www.facebook.com/LineOfSightGlobal/  

https://www.facebook.com/groups/lineofsightglobal/

And you will have good ideas about who we are and what we are set out to do. Thank you very much for support once again. Together, we will show what kind of differences the tight relationship between the community and developer can make. 

Cheers!



ps.
Going back to history little bit, let us tell you how we got end up at Steam. We made the following post in our FB Fan Page back in last May.

=======================================================
May 10th, 2016

Nexon Europe just made an announment that they are no longer the publisher of LoS. This, to many, including ourselves are a big disappointment. Finding another respectable publisher these days, especially for a new PC franchise game, is not an easy task and we cannot afford to have our fans to wait any longer. Well, we thought our next best alternative is to self-publish it. But as a startup, it is a daunting task. However, we are determined to do our best to bring it as soon as possible, say late this summer or early fall. To keep the spirit going, we will need your support and encouragements throughout the process. Your effort to find us here thus far, already assures us that you will do so, am I right? ^^ If you have questions, we would like to take this opportunity to answer some. 
Please let us know. Otherwise, have a great day and we will stay in touch!
